tasks.title: Settled-viewport prefetch trigger evaluation with per-timeframe thresholds
tasks.description: Add the settled-report trigger evaluation: expose the oldest-visible bar ts from the LWC view through the existing _logical/_plotted mapping, and add the host-side evaluator in MainWindow that compares the gap (oldest-visible-ts vs oldest-cached-ts) against T(timeframe) from the S-P19-2 table via session_windows, consulting find_missing_spans for the next older step. This task proves only the fire/silent decision; wave issuance belongs to P19-T2 and no wave is issued by this task's code paths.
acceptance_criteria: Given a settled viewport report (gesture-end, programmatic frame, or initial frame) for any of the nine timeframes in either RTH or ETH mode, when the mode-aware distance between the oldest visible bar ts and the oldest cached bar ts is within T(timeframe) per the trigger table, then a prefetch fire decision is produced, and when the distance exceeds T, then silence is produced, with the boundary single-sided (within fires, beyond does not).

Given live tick traffic or a following-at-edge viewport whose buffer is full, when no new settled report arrives, then no trigger evaluation runs; given a settled report from any chart view (main or pop-out), when evaluated, then the decision is computed per that view against the shared mode-aware cache, and a weekend-closure-only gap produces silence.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a settled viewport report (gesture-end, programmatic frame, or initial frame) for any of the nine timeframes in either RTH or ETH mode, when the mode-aware distance between the oldest visible bar ts and the oldest cached bar ts is within T(timeframe) per the trigger table, then a prefetch fire decision is produced, and when the distance exceeds T, then silence is produced, with the boundary single-sided (within fires, beyond does not).
tests.description: Offscreen parametrized viewport matrix over all nine timeframes (1 min, 5 mins, 15 mins, 30 mins, 1 hour, 4 hours, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month) in RTH and ETH modes asserting fire when within T and silence when beyond T, including the single-sided boundary cell per timeframe, seeded series with clock control and stubbed cache reads; asserts the evaluator's fire/silent decision only, never wave issuance.
tests.expected_result: Within-T cells produce a fire decision, beyond-T cells produce silence, and the boundary cell fires on the within side and stays silent on the beyond side, for every timeframe in both modes.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given live tick traffic or a following-at-edge viewport whose buffer is full, when no new settled report arrives, then no trigger evaluation runs; given a settled report from any chart view (main or pop-out), when evaluated, then the decision is computed per that view against the shared mode-aware cache, and a weekend-closure-only gap produces silence.
tests.description: Offscreen cases asserting the evaluator is not invoked on the live-tick path, a following-at-edge settled report with a full buffer yields silence, per-view reports (main vs pop-out viewports) are evaluated independently against the shared cache, and a gap spanning only a weekend closure yields silence.
tests.expected_result: No evaluation on live ticks; following-at-edge is a no-op; each view evaluates independently; closure-only gaps stay silent.

tasks.title: Ordinary-wave prefetch issuance with coalesce seam and pending marker
tasks.description: Wire a fired trigger to single-step issuance through the existing queue_wave_plans path (exactly one older planner step, pacing-gated, 120 s watchdog, D53 indicator, D56 exactly-once retry, generation fencing, at most one prefetch wave in flight per triple), with the DG111 coalesce seam: a newer trigger arriving mid-wave sets the pending-prefetch marker in TickerSession instead of cancelling, consumed on completion with a fresh re-evaluation and cleared on every terminal path. Mode-switch, symbol-switch and disconnect abandonment reuse the existing generation-bump and cancel paths.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fired trigger for the current (symbol, timeframe, mode) with no wave in flight, when issued, then exactly one older planner step moves through the existing wave lifecycle (pacing-gated, 120 s watchdog, D53 indicator state, D56 exactly-once retry, generation-fenced late arrivals), and a second concurrent wave for the same triple is never in flight.

Given a newer settled trigger arriving while a prefetch wave is in flight, when it arrives, then the running wave is never cancelled and the pending-prefetch marker is set; given wave completion, then the marker is consumed with a fresh-viewport re-evaluation; given any terminal path (completion, strand, cancel, disconnect), then the marker ends cleared; given a mode, symbol, or connection change mid-wave, then the wave and marker are abandoned through the existing generation-bump and cancel paths with no cross-contamination.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a fired trigger for the current (symbol, timeframe, mode) with no wave in flight, when issued, then exactly one older planner step moves through the existing wave lifecycle (pacing-gated, 120 s watchdog, D53 indicator state, D56 exactly-once retry, generation-fenced late arrivals), and a second concurrent wave for the same triple is never in flight.
tests.description: Offscreen wave-lifecycle cases with stubbed transport and clock control asserting the issued plan list holds exactly one planner window, the in-flight cap holds under a second trigger, pacing deferral engages, watchdog strand finalizes, D53 indicator states transition, D56 retry fires exactly once per chunk, and generation-fenced late arrivals are ignored; consumes the P19-T1 fire decision.
tests.expected_result: One step per wave, at most one wave in flight per triple, and every ordinary-wave lifecycle behaviour holds under the stubbed transport.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a newer settled trigger arriving while a prefetch wave is in flight, when it arrives, then the running wave is never cancelled and the pending-prefetch marker is set; given wave completion, then the marker is consumed with a fresh-viewport re-evaluation; given any terminal path (completion, strand, cancel, disconnect), then the marker ends cleared; given a mode, symbol, or connection change mid-wave, then the wave and marker are abandoned through the existing generation-bump and cancel paths with no cross-contamination.
tests.description: Offscreen coalesce-seam cases asserting a mid-wave second trigger never cancels issued chunks and sets the marker, completion consumes the marker with a fresh-viewport re-evaluation, the marker is cleared on completion/strand/cancel/disconnect paths, and mode-switch/symbol-switch/disconnect abandon the wave plus marker with no bars leaking across triples.
tests.expected_result: Coalesce-never-cancel holds, the marker lifecycle is consume-or-clear on every terminal path, and abandonment leaves no cross-contamination.

expected_artifacts: Full P7/P14/P15/P17 wave suites stay green
outputs: One-step ordinary prefetch waves with coalesce seam

tasks.title: Fetch-while-fetchable chaining with honest stops
tasks.description: Extend the prefetch loop so continued scrolling chains wave-after-wave while find_missing_spans reports missing trading-session spans (no arbitrary depth cap, one in flight maintained across the chain via the P19-T2 marker), stopping honestly: no wave when only genuine closures remain, a single AC-D16.4 shortfall with no retry loop beyond D56 per-chunk exactly-once when spans run past retention, and fail-open fall-through to watchdog strand-finalization on pacing exhaustion at fire time.
acceptance_criteria: Given continued scrolling into the past while the planner reports missing trading-session spans, when each wave completes, then the next older step chains (one wave in flight at a time) until the cache covers the viewport, with no arbitrary depth cap.

Given only genuine closures remain, when the evaluator re-runs, then no further wave fires and the closures stay empty; given beyond-retention spans, when the wave strand-finalizes, then the AC-D16.4 shortfall surfaces once with no retry loop beyond D56 per-chunk exactly-once; given pacing exhaustion at fire time, when the trigger fires, then the wave falls through to watchdog strand-finalization fail-open.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given continued scrolling into the past while the planner reports missing trading-session spans, when each wave completes, then the next older step chains (one wave in flight at a time) until the cache covers the viewport, with no arbitrary depth cap.
tests.description: Offscreen deep-scroll cases driving several successive settled reports across multiple planner steps with stubbed transport, asserting each completion chains exactly one older step, the in-flight cap holds across the chain, and coverage extends window by window; builds on the P19-T2 issuance and marker.
tests.expected_result: Chains extend step by step while spans are fetchable, never exceeding one wave in flight, with no depth cap cutting the chain short.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given only genuine closures remain, when the evaluator re-runs, then no further wave fires and the closures stay empty; given beyond-retention spans, when the wave strand-finalizes, then the AC-D16.4 shortfall surfaces once with no retry loop beyond D56 per-chunk exactly-once; given pacing exhaustion at fire time, when the trigger fires, then the wave falls through to watchdog strand-finalization fail-open.
tests.description: Offscreen honest-stop cases: weekend-closure scroll asserts no wave fires and the span stays empty; beyond-retention scroll asserts the AC-D16.4 shortfall surfaces exactly once with chunk retries bounded by D56 exactly-once; pacing-exhausted fire asserts the wave falls through to watchdog strand-finalization without blocking bar delivery.
tests.expected_result: Closure stop stays empty and silent, retention end yields exactly one shortfall with no retry loop, and pacing exhaustion falls through fail-open.

expected_artifacts: Chaining and honest-stop hunks in ui/main_window.py and ui/ticker_session.py

tasks.title: Prefetch honesty, viewport stability, and batch gate
tasks.description: Verify the joint behaviour of the trigger and wave work without production edits: prefetch arrivals render incrementally per chunk with in-flight regions never presented as complete, strand-finalization keeps the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall and closures stay empty, the viewport never moves on any prefetch arrival in either follow state, and the batch gate (full offscreen suite green plus AC-D58.6 history-intact check) passes with no D51/P15/D53/D56 regression.
acceptance_criteria: Given an in-flight prefetch whose chunks land, when bars arrive, then they render incrementally per chunk while the still-missing region stays in-flight via D53 (never presented as complete); given strand-finalization with missing days, then the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall is visible; given genuine closures, then they stay empty.

Given prefetch arrivals under either follow state, when they land, then the visible range is unchanged by the arrival itself (away stays away with an identical range; following extends only via the existing D51 live-update path, never via prefetch), with no fresh-frame request and no range op emitted on any prefetch arrival.

Given the completed batch, when the gate runs, then the full offscreen suite is green and requirements history is intact (marker sentence, Current Tech Stack, and the ### D41 through ### D58 sections with reversals unchanged, no pre-P19 wording touched).

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given an in-flight prefetch whose chunks land, when bars arrive, then they render incrementally per chunk while the still-missing region stays in-flight via D53 (never presented as complete); given strand-finalization with missing days, then the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall is visible; given genuine closures, then they stay empty.
tests.description: Offscreen in-flight/stranded/closure cases asserting per-chunk incremental render counts grow as chunks land, the D53 running state (never complete) holds while the wave runs, the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall text appears at strand finalization, and genuine-closure spans render empty; exercises the joint P19-T2/P19-T3 behaviour with no production edits.
tests.expected_result: Incremental render per chunk, in-flight honesty throughout, verbatim shortfall at strand finalization, closures empty.
